models.title: Traffic restrictions and respiratory health
models.summary: A causal DAG with confounders made explicit, then an effect estimate on data with the backdoor set the DAG demands.
models.question: How much do traffic restrictions improve respiratory health in the city?

models.title: Loss of cooling at the data centre
models.summary: A fault tree with a vote gate on the power supplies — cut sets, importance rankings, and Monte Carlo over the uncertain probabilities.
models.question: How likely is a loss of cooling this year, and what drives it?

models.title: A fishery under quota pressure
models.summary: A stock-and-flow model of a fishery — biomass, recruitment, harvest — with quota scenarios and a Monte Carlo over uncertain growth.
models.question: Can the fishery stay sustainable under the current quota regime?

models.title: Siting the new hospital
models.summary: Three sites, five criteria, swing weights from a board workshop — and the weight at which the answer flips.
models.question: Which site should the new hospital go on?

models.title: Unusual activity on the network
models.summary: Three hypotheses, eight pieces of evidence, and the matrix that shows which hypothesis the evidence fails to rule out.
models.question: What explains the unusual outbound traffic on the finance VLAN?

models.title: Launch, license, or do nothing
models.summary: A decision tree with the value of knowing demand before choosing — and the probability at which the answer flips.
models.question: Should we launch the product ourselves, license it, or do nothing?

models.title: Does mentoring raise school completion?
models.summary: A theory of change with process tracing — each link's posterior, the tests that matter, and an impact estimate on register data.
models.question: Does the mentoring programme raise school completion, and how would we know?

models.title: An EV subsidy in the regional transport system
models.summary: A fuzzy cognitive map elicited from stakeholders — clamp the subsidy and watch the system settle somewhere new.
models.question: What does an EV subsidy do to emissions, congestion and household costs across the region?

models.title: Is the screening programme worth its cost?
models.summary: A Markov cohort over thirty years — costs, QALYs, the ICER, and the strategy the committee's willingness-to-pay threshold picks.
models.question: Is a national bowel-cancer screening programme cost-effective at the usual threshold?

models.title: Sepsis risk on the ward
models.summary: A Bayesian network over sepsis risk. Condition on what you've observed — a rising SOFA score, a high lactate — and watch the posteriors move.
models.question: How likely is a deteriorating ward patient to develop sepsis, and which observations change that most?
